LAKE - PORTER COUNTY REGIONAL TRANSPORTATION & PLANNING COMMISSION JOHN S. VASCONA, President - NORMAN E. TUFFORD, Executive Director 81.9 Kerry Cy Ave. Highway, Indiana 40322
PROJECT NUMBER:
NIPC #74-228
APPLICANT'S NAME:
Illinois Department of Transportation
PROGRAM DESCRIPTION: Improvements to Route #23, Lincoln Highway
DATE OF IPC ACTION:
May 22nd, 1974
The Interstate Planning Committee concurred with the position taken by the Northeastern Illinois Planning Commission on this application. The Committee was satisfied that there was no unresolved conflict between the two jurisdictions, N.E. Illinois and N.W. Indiana, and voted unanimously to endorse the application without additional comments.
